ideas.title: Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program: A case study in alleged fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future program and the involvement of high-ranking officials
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the program's finances
questions: What was the extent of the alleged fraud?
How did high-ranking officials respond to allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on the accountability of state officials
